title: hunch_task finish and hunch_report return the full report inline and exceed host tool-result limits
observation: hunch_task(action: finish) and hunch_report(task_id) return the entire hunch.task-report/1 document as structuredContent, including every delivered envelope's full context text and every record's lesson text. A task with 18 context deliveries produced a 101,623-character finish result and a 95,634-character report result; the Claude Code host refused both as exceeding the tool-result token limit and wrote them to a file, so the contribution card the agent must relay was not visible to it without a shell round-trip. The card itself is ~6 lines. The plan (docs/next-release-memory-impact.md) asks for a concise card plus references; the full report belongs to `hunch report --json` and the HTML view, not to the MCP round-trip.
